material.description: blocked_by: gap-data-reload-keeps-match-state. Facts (remote main a69d4b3c): room.rs step() swaps the staged Sim (~237-241) with no carry. Per-unit carry needs the unit type index: Sim.type_of is pub(crate) with no pub accessor in sim/src/arrays.rs, so kind cannot be mapped by name into the new catalog. hp is settable only via private fields; spawn_for resets hp to full. Sim::load_state restores hp, ids and positions but copies the OLD terrain flags/tiles and keeps the new catalog, so using it would silently drop map.star terrain edits. Needed: a read-only pub unit_type(i) -> Option<u32> and a pub hp setter in sim, outside this lane. A new Ev for match_carried needs log.rs (other lane); fallback is Ev::DataReloaded with carried=/dropped= fields.
material.resolution: A data swap carries each live unit's health; pinned test passes on the green tip.
material.subject: Carry live units across a data swap needs sim accessors outside this lane
material.witness: verifier gm-orch-6-v1-ms1 at c003bda (green 24/24): carry_live_units sets health from old unit (room.rs:415-436); pinned test carry_keeps_old_health passes live (cargo test -p server, 1 passed).

note: A data swap carries each live unit's health; pinned test passes on the green tip.
